terms.definition: The external agentic backend that drives sessions. NotNativeDesktop never imports harness internals; all traffic rides a seam adapter.
One connected harness origin the UI targets. Every live-side cache and async completion is scoped and guarded by its runtime key.
A presentation context such as web or desktop. Surfaces share one UI package and differ only through capability adapters.
The canonical normalized path a session is bound to. Directory keys are normalized before any store, cache, or routing use.
A conversation bound to a directory, carrying turns of work. Session identity spans runtime, directory, and session id.
One ordered entry of a session transcript. Messages order by created time with id tie-break, never by id.
A rendered unit of a message, such as text, tool call, or reasoning. Parts upsert by part id inside a message bucket.
A harness emitted blocker that gates an action until the user replies. Permissions route to the owning session, not the containing store.
A harness emitted request for user input that blocks the turn until answered or rejected.
Harness owned checklist state for a session, mirrored into the UI and persisted per session identity.
A git worktree directory that sessions can be created in or moved to, used by multi run fan out.
The live channel carrier that selects transports, keeps order per directory, coalesces safely, and reconnects with backoff.
The carrier choice between server sent events and WebSocket frames. Transport selection and fallback stay inside the pipeline.
The event container shape carrying id, type, and properties. Envelope normalization happens once on arrival.
Delivering one ordered flush of queued events to their owning directory store in a single publication.
Merging queued replace-type events and concatenating deltas by key so flush frames stay bounded under burst.
A server signal that widens flush frames for a bounded window so a slow client drains without dropping order.
The replay position of the live stream, updated from stream ids and page responses, never advancing past proven data.
The staged first paint sequence for a directory: critical snapshot, deferred enrichment, then the authoritative session list.
The closure that proves an async completion still belongs to the current run, store, runtime, and loader before it may publish.
A user turn rendered before harness confirmation, restored exactly when the send fails and confirmed in place when ambiguous.
A fetched list or status map that replaces stored state, including empty results, provenance tracked by list source.
A deletion revision that beats later overlay merges so archive and delete survive bootstrap replay.
The cooldown guarded scheduler that refetches missing transcript slices after gaps instead of trusting partial state.
The bounded disposal of directory stores and message maps by access time, grace, and pending request safety.
The periodic check that repairs stuck or stale sessions through monotonic status polls and stream gap detection.
A stale while revalidate store snapshot that paints instantly and is replaced by authoritative data, never an authority itself.
The message lifecycle view of activity that decides which sessions present a streaming indicator.
The single HTTP authority for transcript pages, with cursor paging, in flight sharing, and generation guards.
A script enforced check in the repository quality suite. Gates are deterministic evidence before any judgment.
The composition root owning child stores, loader, routing, pipeline, watchdog, and materialization for each runtime.
Applying a fresh authority against live state while preserving terminal outcomes and never regressing written progress.
An installable add-on with a manifest, activation lifecycle, and route slots governed by NNA. NNO and NND mount as packages.
One scoped NNA engine instance bound to a surface, principal entitlement, and directory root. Contexts spawn per consumer.
An authoritative block of engine state pushed on the wire, carrying turn state and replay cursors. Clients present frames and never derive them.
The native desktop container that renders the served web GUI and manages connections. The shell presents; the harness asserts.
